verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships an official CLI (`clai`) explicitly for chatting with LLMs via natural language from the terminal, and can also launch a coding-agent CLI mode with NL-driven planning, file access, and repo orientation, letting AI-native users operate it conversationally rather than only via Python APIs. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the CLI's NL command experience (evidence is all first-party docs) and more detail on the breadth of NL commands it supports beyond chat/coding-agent scenarios.
